summary: Road end beside bushland, cars already park here, nearest mapped home about 23 m.
reasons: Backs onto dense bush at the road end
Cars already park in the turning head

best_section.where: North kerb at the dead-end turning head, against the bushland

drivers.seclusion: Bush runs along the west edge of the turning head; mapped houses are 23 m (at 0 m) and 20 m (at 21 m) away, with a house on the north side screened by palms.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed turning head wide enough to pull in; several cars park there already.
drivers.traffic: Dead-end residential street; only local traffic.
drivers.convention: Parked cars at the end of the street; no campers seen.

flags: Two No Stopping Any Time signs sit about 10-13 m from the kerb line near the start, so check the arrows on site
Witton Creek mapped about 2 m away, min elevation 38 m
sun_shade: Bush to the west shades the afternoon; the turning head is open to the morning sun.
